import { codexReadiness, withCodexWorkspace, sessionCompleted, profiles, ordinaryResearchPrompt, researchQuestion, groundedAnswer, groundedResearchQuestion, validateGrounding, assessGroundedAnswer, perspectiveCandidates, chooseLenses, perspectiveResearch, basicFacts, outlineResearch, validateOutline, reviseOutline, renderOutline, createInvestigation, reviseInvestigation, validateInvestigation, renderInvestigation, advanceInvestigation, createEvidenceTable, validateEvidenceTable, reviseEvidenceTable, renderEvidenceTable, evidenceTableResearch, createReport, validateReport, reviseReport, draftReportSection, renderReport, researchActivity } from '@pradeeptathineni/research-ai';
import type { ResearchActivity, ResearchResult, SessionOutcome, SessionCleanup, FrozenSource, PerspectiveResult, ResearchOutline, Investigation, InvestigationBudget, InvestigationQuestion, ResearchEvidenceTable, EvidenceTableColumn, ResearchReport, ReportParagraph } from '@pradeeptathineni/research-ai';
import { legacy } from './shape.mjs';
const cleanup: SessionCleanup = { complete: true, error: null };
const outcome: SessionOutcome = { ...legacy, cleanup };
const result: ResearchResult = { status: 'complete', answer: outcome.final, receipt: {
  profile: 'quick', model: 'fixture', effort: 'high', provider: null, searches: 0,
  actionCounts: outcome.actionCounts, nativeSessions: 1, stages: outcome.stages,
  termination: outcome.termination, terminal: outcome.terminal, cleanup,
} };
const sources: FrozenSource[] = [{ uri: 'https://example.org', text: 'Captured text' }];
const grounded = groundedAnswer({ sources, judge: { id: 'typed', kind: 'synthetic' }, claims: [{ text: 'Unknown.', citations: [], joint: { verdict: 'insufficient', reason: 'No evidence.' } }] });
validateGrounding(grounded.answer, grounded.grounding);
void groundedResearchQuestion;
void assessGroundedAnswer({ sources, claims: [] }, { identity: grounded.grounding.judge, judge: async () => ({ verdict: 'unknown', reason: 'No judgment.' }) });
async function consumer() {
  const ready = await codexReadiness();
  const direct = await withCodexWorkspace({ lease: '/tmp/typed-example', prefix: 'typed-' }, ws => ws.run({
    prompt: ordinaryResearchPrompt('Question'), live: false, budget: profiles.quick, signal: new AbortController().signal,
  }));
  const research = await researchQuestion('Question', { sources, model: result.receipt.model });
  return [ready.available, sessionCompleted(outcome), direct.cleanup.complete, research.receipt.cleanup.error];
}
void consumer;
const lenses = chooseLenses(sources, [perspectiveCandidates(sources)[0]?.id ?? basicFacts.id, { label: 'Renter', focus: 'Costs without building changes' }]);
async function perspectives(): Promise<PerspectiveResult['status']> {
  const viewed = await perspectiveResearch('Topic', { sources, perspectives: 'auto', questions: 2, onLens: ({ id, state }) => void [id, state] });
  return viewed.lenses[0]?.questions?.[0]?.citations[0]?.occurrence === 'exact-retained-span' ? viewed.status : 'failed';
}
void [lenses, perspectives];
const investigationBudget: InvestigationBudget = { ...profiles.quick, calls: 12 };
const investigationQuestion: InvestigationQuestion = { id: 'q1', parentId: null, question: 'What changes?' };
const investigation: Investigation = createInvestigation('Topic', { questions: [investigationQuestion], budget: investigationBudget });
const revisedInvestigation = reviseInvestigation(validateInvestigation(investigation), { scope: 'Offline first' });
void [renderInvestigation(revisedInvestigation), advanceInvestigation];
const outline: ResearchOutline | null = null;
void [outline, outlineResearch, validateOutline, reviseOutline, renderOutline];
const tableColumns: EvidenceTableColumn[] = [{ id: 'retention', title: 'Retention', question: 'How long?' }];
const table: ResearchEvidenceTable = createEvidenceTable('Compare', { sources, columns: tableColumns });
const editedTable = reviseEvidenceTable(validateEvidenceTable(table), { question: 'Compare captured values' });
void [renderEvidenceTable(editedTable), evidenceTableResearch];
const report: ResearchReport = createReport(editedTable);
const reviewed: ResearchReport = reviseReport(validateReport(report), { sectionId: 'retention', paragraphs: [{ text: 'Captured retention.', citations: [{ source: 0, start: 0, end: 6, quote: 'Naïve ' }] }] });
const paragraph: ReportParagraph = reviewed.sections[0].versions[0].paragraphs[0];
void [draftReportSection, renderReport(reviewed), paragraph];
const onActivity = (event: ResearchActivity): void => {
  if (event.kind === 'web.completed') { const url: string | null = event.detail.url; void [url, event.detail.urlStatus]; }
  if (event.kind === 'session.settled') { const done: boolean = event.detail.completed; void [done, event.sequence, event.observedAt]; }
};
void [researchQuestion('Typed activity', { activity: onActivity }), researchActivity.kinds, researchActivity.version];
